Jules (AE): Procurement put the Redwood Dedicated quote on hold. They want ISO scope page + SOC2 bridge letter + a signed pen-test confirmation before PO release. Also asking if we can allow their 72h external scan against an isolated tenant.
Ezra (SE): We can spin an isolated tenant in staging. Need their scan IP CIDRs and estimated peak qps. If they expect high sustained throughput, pricing moves.
Mina (Security): We have a pen-test confirmation template. Legal must approve the signer name. We can provide SOC2 bridge letter and a redacted ISO scope page.
Jules (AE): Customer is explicit: "attestation must show remediation of critical/high findings in last 12 months". Can we provide that without exposing internal tickets?
Mina (Security): Yes — we'll deliver a remediation summary table (date, summary, risk level, ticket ref). No raw ticket exports.
Ezra (SE): For test data: recommend synthetic or presigned objects with tight expiry & IP restrict. Do not use prod snapshots.
Ezra (SE): ```bash
# presign example
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-staging/val-test.tar.gz --expires-in 900
# enforce bucket policy to specific IPs
```
Tara (Legal): I'll review the attestation signer and liability language. If they request CISO-level signature, we may need exec sign-off. Also recommend a short SOW for scope and indemnity.
Mina (Security): Flag: if tester wants authenticated tests with service accounts, we will issue a short-lived service principal (48h) and rotate keys after. We will stream audit logs to them in read-only mode.
infra-bot: Ticket SEC-4410 created: "ValenTrust attestation + staging scan coordination" assigned to Mina (Security). Priority: high.
Ezra (SE): Ballpark cost impact: +12% on Dedicated quote for reserved burst & ops standby for 72h scan. Will firm up after they share qps.
Jules (AE): Action items: Mina -> attach SOC2 bridge + ISO scope excerpt + draft attestation; Tara -> review signer/SOW; Ezra -> confirm staging runbook & cost delta; I'll chase buyer for tester name, insurance cert, and scan IPs.
Jules (AE): Customer asked for the window next Wed-Thu. Can we commit?
Ezra (SE): Tentatively yes pending infra confirmation of capacity. I'll lock after cost approved.
Mina (Security): Also require tester to sign our testing rules (no kernel fuzzing, no physical access). Include insurance cert and named tester in scope.
Jules (AE): Great, thanks all. I'll update procurement after attachments are ready. :thumbsup:
